Subject: Vendor onboarding: Redwood Inference / Lumos AI — payment terms

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for the onboarding checklist — we're excited to get Lumos AI set up as a vendor for the usage-based inference connectors. A couple of items from our side that I'd like to flag early so procurement and finance can align:

- Our standard billing cadence is Net 60; we typically submit monthly invoices and receive payment within 60 days.
- We can compress to Net 45 for an express relationship, but moving to Net 30 would be a stretch for us unless there is an early settlement or advance arrangement for the first one or two invoices.
- I'll attach our W-9 and the completed vendor onboarding form; please confirm receipt and whether Redwood supports short-term accelerated settlement pilots (e.g., payment within 10 business days in exchange for a small discount).

Attachments: Lumos_W-9.pdf; vendor_onboarding_form_filled.pdf

High level ask: Can Redwood confirm the PO acceptance flow and whether an early-settlement pilot is an option while we complete the standard Net45/Net60 setup? If useful, happy to jump on a quick call.

Best,

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 08:24:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: Redwood Inference / Lumos AI — payment terms

Thanks for the ping, Soojin. Looping in Finance policy notes and next steps here.

Short answers up front:
- Standard onboarding: Net 45 for new vendors by default (Net 30 reserved for strategic vendors with credit checks). Net 60 is allowed but requires CFO approval and a rationale.
- Early settlement: We do run a short-term accelerated-settlement pilot through our AP partner. The program can be used for the first 30–60 days of activity for new suppliers, subject to a contractual MOU and a finance approval. Typical economics are a 1–3% discount for settlement within 10 business days.
- PO flow: For usage-based connectors we prefer a PO (PO# required for automated routing), but we can accept the first invoice against a signed MSA/SOW and create the PO retroactively while the portal is being finalized.

Action items I propose:
1) Soojin: confirm Lumos agrees to Net45 and whether they will accept a 2% discount for a 10-day early settlement pilot on month 1–2.
2) Karthik / Procurement: prepare temporary PO flow guidance and the vendor registration checklist.
3) Finance (Marissa): draft a short MOU (1 page) describing pilot terms and attach the early-settlement mechanics. I'll attach a template.

Attachment: mou-early-settlement-draft.docx

Marissa Cole
Revenue Operations & Billing Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Thanks — we can accept Net45 as the baseline. Regarding the early settlement pilot, Lumos is open to a 2% discount in exchange for payment within 10 business days on the first two invoices while we finish full portal onboarding. That should be acceptable to our treasury team.

We attached a sample invoice for the anticipated first month to help you size the pilot (invoice_001.pdf). If you can route the MOU and the temporary PO guidance I can get our legal and AP to sign quickly.

Best,
Taylor

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Taylor Brooks <taylor@lumosai.com>, soojin_lee@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 15:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: Redwood Inference / Lumos AI — payment terms

Taylor / Soojin / Marissa — quick alignment from procurement:

1) We will accept Lumos as a vendor with Net45 standard terms for onboarding. No CFO exception required.
2) We will run a 60-day early-settlement pilot for the first two invoices: 2% discount if Lumos accepts payment within 10 business days. Pilot is conditional on: (a) signed 1-page MOU (Marissa to share), (b) vendor registration completed (forms we received), and (c) creation of a PO within 5 business days of first invoice submission.
3) PO policy: Procurement can issue a retroactive PO to enable immedate provisioning. For automation, please send the signed SOW and invoice to procurement@redwood.ai and we will create PO# and route to AP.

Next steps:
- Marissa: share MOU and routing instructions (done).
- Taylor: confirm acceptance of 2% / sign MOU; send invoice_001.pdf to procurement@redwood.ai when ready.
- Soojin: coordinate a short kick-off call if needed.

Thanks — Karthik
